prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.6%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Split Screen Story Welcome', 'Interactive Waiting Room Flow', 'Custom Pet Live Preview Flow']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Desktop Pet Control Guide Screen', 'Interactive Pet Choice Cards Grid', 'Account Persistence Warning Hint', 'Animated Companion Arrival Flow', 'Desktop Arrival Quick Reference', 'Spotlight Path Selection Layout', 'Estimated Wait Time Indicator', 'Account Persistence Clarification', 'Account Save Protection Headline', 'Companion Unlock Badge Incentive', 'Grid Layout Path Choice', 'Desktop Spawn Location Placement Guidance', 'Photo Quality Guidance Tip Carousel', 'Active Wait Status & Notification Option', 'Cloud Save Protection Reassurance', 'Story Step Progress Indicator']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Starter Accessory Incentive Badge', 'Centered Adoption Certificate Layout', 'Interactive Split Pet Selector', 'Photo Upload Clarity Hint', 'Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen', 'Post-Adoption Account Registration Flow', 'Desktop Sanctuary Arrival Setup Flow', 'Stage Layout Pet Naming Certificate', 'Interactive Gesture Interaction Tutorial Screen', 'Story Carousel Path Discovery']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but winning new_flow changes in round 3 were under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
finish copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for kinds of change tested only once, as well as home new_flow which had mixed results across 2 tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Delayed Sign-In Reorder Flow
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to immediately follow adoption certificate creation so users connect with their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel. Delaying registration until after pet creation leverages commitment bias.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive desktop visibility test step where users trigger a quick wave animation to confirm their pet rendered on screen.
candidates.why: Finish drops to 64.8% conversion with long completion time, and 3 support tickets complained about pets failing to appear on desktop.

new_visibility_check.headline: Locate Your Desktop Pet
new_visibility_check.body: Your pet is active on your desktop screen! Click below to send a wave signal and verify positioning.

candidates.title: Customization Sound & Visual Studio Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign pet selection into a dynamic stage layout with real-time sound effects and prominent previews for custom options.
candidates.why: Adoption has a long median time (89s) and custom pet visuals generated 3 support complaints regarding output visual quality.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Greeting Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated interaction screen at the end of onboarding where users practice their first pet greeting command.
candidates.why: Support emails showed confusion around controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_pet_talk_intro.headline: Say Hello to Your Pet!
new_pet_talk_intro.body: Try giving your pet its very first greeting command to see how it responds on your desktop.

components.text: Click below to test desktop response

candidates.title: Desktop Preparation System Notification
candidates.change: Enable optional OS notifications during background pet rendering so users are alerted as soon as their companion is ready.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a huge mean of 2336s, indicating users tab away during background generation and forget to return.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready to pop onto your screen.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Perk Incentive
candidates.change: Display unique personality perk badges on path selection to motivate users during initial path choice.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a high mean duration (514s), reflecting user indecision during initial path selection.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet's Origin Story
choose_path.body: Each path unlocks unique traits, rare animations, and special companion behaviors.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Sync Account Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight data persistence and memory backup across desktop sessions.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, creating anxiety around sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Protect & Sync Your Pet's Memories
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet's age, learned tricks, and custom items remain safe even if you switch computers.

candidates.title: Split Photo Upload Verification Layout
candidates.change: Change photo upload screen layout to split view showing real-time lighting and angle requirements alongside photo upload.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or produces poor visual results according to 3 support tickets.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide clear front-facing lighting to help our engine render your pet's features accurately.

candidates.title: Welcome Gift Accessory Unlock Incentive
candidates.change: Offer an instant desktop starter item reward badge on the final onboarding welcome screen.
candidates.why: Finish screen conversion drops to 64.8% with median time of 395s; providing a reward incentivizes completing final setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Work & Play!
home_intro.body: Complete setup now to receive a complimentary desktop starter toy for your pet.

candidates.title: Live Generation Step Checklist Progress
candidates.change: Display active multi-step rendering progress counters during pet creation waiting room.
candidates.why: Home wait step has high mean (2336s) and median (201s) time; step-by-step feedback maintains active user engagement.
